grammarFocus: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but。
title: Simulated Listening: A Family Meal
instructions: 这是模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。听录音前先读题。录音会播放两遍。第一遍听大意，第二遍听细节。所有答案必须来自录音原文。填空题只填一个单词，且该单词必须与录音中的完全一致。单选题选择最符合录音内容的选项。
transcript: Mia: Hi, Leo. Does your family eat together? Leo: Yes, we do. We eat at seven. Mia: What do you like? Leo: I like rice and vegetables. Mia: Does your sister like rice? Leo: No, she doesn't. She likes noodles. Mia: Can you cook? Leo: I can cook eggs, but I cannot cook noodles. Mia: Can your sister cook? Leo: Yes, she can. She can cook noodles and rice. Mia: Does your father cook? Leo: No, he doesn't. He likes fish, but he cannot cook fish. Mia: And your mother? Leo: She can cook fish. She likes fish and vegetables. Mia: So your mother cooks fish? Leo: Yes, she does. And my sister cooks noodles. I cook eggs. We are a happy family.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do/does问答；like；can/cannot；and/but
grammar.explanation: 在一般现在时中，当主语是he、she、it或单数名词时，动词要加-s或-es，例如likes、cooks。疑问句用does，后面动词用原形，例如Does she like rice? 回答用Yes, she does.或No, she doesn't. can表示能力，后面动词用原形，否定形式是cannot，例如cannot cook。and连接并列内容，but表示转折。
grammar.example: She likes noodles. Does your father cook? No, he doesn't. I can cook eggs, but I cannot cook noodles.

questions.explanation: 主语She是第三人称单数，动词like要加-s，变成likes。rice是不可数名词，不加-s。
主语he是第三人称单数，疑问句用Does，后面动词用原形cook。
cannot后面动词用原形cook，不能加-s。cannot是一个词，不分开写。
